name: update_shipping_address_corrected_house_number
use_case: Change or cancel an order before it ships
branch: Customer requests address update on processing order and immediately corrects a typo in the street number
tests: the agent updates the shipping address for order O432 to the exact corrected address 452 Elm St, Austin, TX 78701
instruction:
You placed order O432 and want to update its delivery address because you made a typo. You first say 450 Elm St, then immediately correct the house number to 452 Elm St, Austin, TX 78701, and confirm the address change.

Your details:
Name: David Kim
Email: david.kim@example.com
Postal code: 78701
Order ID: O432
New Address: 452 Elm St, Austin, TX 78701

persona.name: David Kim
persona.initial_message: Hello, I made a mistake on the shipping address for order O432. Please send it to 450 Elm St... wait, typo, I meant 452 Elm St, Austin, TX 78701.

fixed.new_address: caller: corrected address 452 Elm St, Austin, TX 78701
